items.title: 56706_Buddy Tate oral history interview
items.q: we got to do another album for Carl Jefferson real soon.

ctx.x: Uh-huh. She brought me the tape of Scott. So I says, 'Who's this?' She said, 'You ain't going to believe this. This is a young kid I found up in Providence.' I said, 'What?' So I says, 'Yes, yeah, he sounds beautiful.' So I'm trying to remember our first gig. I can't remember the first gig we had together, because she handles him, too, you know. She books him. And I'm trying to remember the first gig we did together. Anyway, I can't remember the gig, the first gig. But there was -- I'd been hearing a lot of nice…

So I said, 'Well, I think you'd be satisfied with him.' When did I meet him now? I can't remember. They booked us somewhere together and we just meld together -- man, we can do a lot of things together. We got another -- we got to do another album for Carl Jefferson real soon. They took off the 19th and went to -- he's in Europe now. I'll see him in Europe. They're going to be over there. He went to Copenhagen. Not Copenhagen, but Stockholm. And he's going to Warsaw and he's got George Messel and Warren Vaché.…
Does Shirley do all your booking?
